parameters.description:
Score function (or loss function) with signature
``score_func(y, y_pred, **kwargs)``.
parameters.name: score_func

parameters.description:
Specifies the response method to use get prediction from an estimator
(i.e. :term:`predict_proba`, :term:`decision_function` or
:term:`predict`). Possible choices are:

- if `str`, it corresponds to the name to the method to return;
- if a list or tuple of `str`, it provides the method names in order of
  preference. The method returned corresponds to the first method in
  the list and which is implemented by `estimator`.

.. versionadded:: 1.4
parameters.name: response_method
parameters.type_doc: {"predict_proba", "decision_function", "predict"} or list/tuple of such str, default="predict"

parameters.description:
Whether `score_func` is a score function (default), meaning high is
good, or a loss function, meaning low is good. In the latter case, the
scorer object will sign-flip the outcome of the `score_func`.
parameters.name: greater_is_better

parameters.description: Additional parameters to be passed to `score_func`.
parameters.name: kwargs

returns.description: Callable object that returns a scalar score; greater is better.
returns.name: scorer

summary: Make a scorer from a performance metric or loss function.
